The must-sees

5 places Wizzy will tap you for first, each with a story and something to look for.

  1. 01
    Viewpoint · 1488

    Diaz Point

    The Portuguese explorer landed here in 1488. A wooden boardwalk leads to the cross and views of the coast.

  2. 02
    Church · 1912

    Felsenkirche

    Consecrated in 1912, it stands on Diamond Hill above the town and the bay. The town’s German Lutheran congregation built it during the diamond boom.

    Look for

    Inside, the stained-glass window above the altar was a gift from Kaiser Wilhelm II.

  3. 03
    Building · 1910

    Goerke Haus

    Hans Goerke built it in 1910 at the height of the diamond rush. Few houses in Namibia show the boom’s wealth so plainly.

    Look for

    See how the house is set into the rock of Diamond Hill, with its terraces and steps climbing the slope.

  4. 04
    Landmark · 1908

    Kolmanskop

    A worker found a diamond here in 1908 and a rich town followed. Abandoned by 1956, its houses are now filled with dunes.

    Look for

    In the old community hall, find the skittle alley where the town’s German residents bowled in the boom years.

  5. 05
    Landmark · 1905

    Shark Island

    Between 1905 and 1907, thousands of Nama and Herero prisoners died here. The memorial is a place of remembrance.
